blocks.text: Documents the two-patch history (A8 for status routes, A4 for propose/confirm/deny), explains why the GET routes were left in place after the CLI was removed, and describes how the propose/confirm/deny trio reuses local_workspace_tools' existing pending-action store.
blocks.title: Module header and imports

blocks.text: _require_workspace is a local copy of local_workspace.py's same helper. The two GET routes are thin pass-throughs: get_mcp_servers returns whatever list_mcp_servers() gives back; get_mcp_server_status returns whatever mcp_server_status() gives back, including {error:...} for unknown names.
blocks.title: Workspace guard and MCP status routes

blocks.text: ProposeMCPActionRequest carries the agent-tool name (f'mcp__{server}__{tool}') and arguments dict. mcp_propose_action validates via propose_mcp_action() and returns a ProposeMCPActionResponse. A 400 means the tool name is malformed or the tool is classified read-only; the MCP server is never contacted.
blocks.title: Propose route for mutating MCP tools

blocks.text: mcp_confirm_action calls confirm_action() from local_workspace_tools — the same function used by local_workspace.py's confirm route. The pending action's stored source field determines which backend (daemon or MCP) is actually reached. mcp_deny_action is synchronous and never contacts the MCP server.
blocks.title: Confirm and deny

concepts: read-only vs mutating MCP tool classification
gotchas: _require_workspace is a local copy of the same helper in local_workspace.py — deliberately not imported from there to keep the two files independently testable
get_mcp_server_status returns {error:...} for an unknown server name rather than 404 — this is intentional for CLI compatibility
read-only MCP tools have no route here; they are called directly without propose/confirm
how_it_works: get_mcp_servers calls list_mcp_servers() synchronously — a summary of configured servers plus live-connection state, no network attempt
get_mcp_server_status awaits mcp_server_status(server_name) — may connect to introspect live tools; returns {error:...} for unknown names instead of raising
mcp_propose_action validates the f'mcp__{server}__{tool}' name and stores a pending action; MCP server not contacted
mcp_confirm_action awaits confirm_action() from local_workspace_tools — the same function local_workspace.py's confirm route calls; which backend it reaches depends on the action's stored source
mcp_deny_action calls deny_action() synchronously; MCP server never contacted
outputs: server list/status dicts, ProposeMCPActionResponse on propose, MCP tool result on confirm, {status: denied} on deny
purpose: Wires HTTP routes to two functions in eo/capabilities.py (list_mcp_servers and mcp_server_status) that previously had no HTTP surface, and adds propose→confirm/deny routes for MUTATING-classified MCP tools. Reuses the same pending-action store that local_workspace.py uses for daemon tools, so both tool families share one confirmation mechanism.
side_effects: pending action written to store on propose
summary: FastAPI router for MCP server status queries and the propose/confirm/deny flow for mutating MCP tool calls.
